sentences.japanese: 自分のかっこ良さをわざと隠すということ？
sentences.english: You are saying you intentionally hide your good looks?

sentences.japanese: 金は床板の下に隠されていた。
sentences.english: The money was hidden beneath the floorboards.

sentences.japanese: 享子の見えないところにブルーベリージャムを隠してね。
sentences.english: Please hide the blueberry jam where Takako can't see it.

sentences.japanese: 気持ちを隠さず話しなさい。
咳、くしゃみ、あくびをする時は口を手で隠しなさい。
sentences.english: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
